svg.title: Visual Fashion Product Search - Graduation Project
svg.desc: Editable 2500 by 1400 millimetre poster. Text, charts, shapes and QR code are vectors.
svg.text: An image-based fashion search application that retrieves visually
similar garments from a local catalogue. Users can search the full
photo or select one garment before retrieval.
Several garments and background details can distract whole-image
search. Selecting the intended piece gives the encoder a more focused
Retrieve visually similar clothing from an image.
Refine the target with positive and negative SAM2 points.
Support local product entry and management.
Evaluate search with clearly defined relevance.
Actual application screens. Interface verification is separate from retrieval accuracy.
Historical test: 100 synthetic two-item queries. Category relevance, not exact-product identity.
Actual ranked results for the pictured cutout. Visual similarity does not guarantee the same commercial item.
Source code, editable documentation and runtime
